title: API & Skill
subtitle: Let other agents and scripts generate music on this computer

http.title: HTTP API
http.lanOn: Devices on the same network can call it through this computer’s IP. Without a token, no authentication is required.
http.lanOff: Only this computer (127.0.0.1) can access it
http.requireTokenHint: Off by default: anyone who knows the address can generate music. When on, calls must include the token.
http.regenerate: Regenerate (the old token stops working immediately)
http.discoveryHint: Skill clients read the address and token from it automatically

endpoints.health: Health check, engine, and installed models (no token needed)
endpoints.install: Download or resume downloading a model
endpoints.create: Submit a generation job (returns an id)

skill.title: Agent Skill
skill.description: The skill bundles usage instructions (SKILL.md), a dependency-free Python client, and the API reference. Once installed, agents such as Claude Code and Codex can respond to “write me a song” directly.
skill.otherLocationHint: Choose the agent’s skills folder; a songhearth folder is created inside it
skill.previewHint: See the instructions agents will read
